## Pressures

Understanding of Pressures

```{r}
#| out-width: "100%"
#| fig-cap: "Seasonal sea level anomaly, seasonal sea surface temperature and Degree Heating Weeks at the scale of Ningaloo Marine Park. Solid lines represent mean values for sea level anomaly (SLA), sea surface temperature (SST) and Degree Heating Weeks (DHW). Confidence bounds represent standard errors. Red dashed vertical lines represent maximum DHW values that are plotted spatially in Figure B.4."
include_graphics(here("plots/ningaloo/pressures/ningaloo_oceanography_time-series.png"))
```

```{r}
#| out-width: "90%"
#| fig-cap: "Sea level anomaly, as an index of upwelling, at the scale of Ningaloo Marine Park. Heatmap values represent high (yellow) and low (blue) bimonthy sea level anomaly (SLA). Grey polygons represent State spatial management and Australian Marine Park boundaries."
include_graphics(here("plots/ningaloo/pressures/ningaloo_SLA.png"))
```

```{r}
#| out-width: "90%"
#| fig-cap: "Sea surface temperature at the scale of Ningaloo Marine Park. Heatmap values represent high (yellow) and low (blue) bimonthy sea surface temperature (SST). Grey polygons represent State spatial management and Australian Marine Park boundaries."
include_graphics(here("plots/ningaloo/pressures/ningaloo_SST.png"))
```

```{r}
#| out-width: "90%"
#| fig-cap: "Maximum Degree Heating Weeks at the scale of Ningaloo Marine Park. Heatmap values representing high (yellow) and low (blue) monthly Degree Heating Weeks (DHW) for the two most recent marine heatwave periods on record. Grey polygons represent State spatial management and Australian Marine Park boundaries."
include_graphics(here("plots/ningaloo/pressures/ningaloo_DHW.png"))
```

```{r}
#| out-width: "90%"
#| fig-cap: "Late winter (June-September) sea surface temperature anomaly at the scale of Ningaloo Marine Park from 1850 to 2026, relative to the 1961-1990 average. Red bars represent years warmer than average and blue bars years cooler than average. Data from NOAA ERSST v6, a 2° monthly reconstruction from ship, buoy and Argo float observations, averaged over the ERSST grid cells overlapping the park; values before 1940 are less certain due to sparse observations."
include_graphics(here("plots/ningaloo/pressures/ningaloo_SST_anomaly.png"))
```
